title: A Lifting-Based Interface Reduction Framework for Nonlinear Transmission and Eigenvalue Problems
summary: We present a lifting-based interface reduction framework for nonlinear transmission and eigenvalue problems. The method represents the solution as a sum of a bulk component and a lifting component that carries the interface jump, thereby reducing the original problem to a nonlinear system posed on the interface. A low-dimensional approximation is obtained by restricting the interface unknown to a finite-dimensional subspace.
